jobs.title: Airport Field Technician Lead – Denver International Airport - CDL B Required
jobs.description:
About Our Job

With competitive pay, great benefits, and endless opportunities, working for the City and County of Denver means seeing yourself working with purpose — for you, and those who benefit from your passion, skills and expertise. Join our diverse, inclusive and talented workforce of more than 11,000 team members who are at the heart of what makes Denver, Denver.

What We Offer

The City and County of Denver offers competitive pay commensurate with education and experience. The salary range for this position is $26.56-$45.82. New hires are typically brought into the organization between $36.75-41.50/hour based on experience. We also offer generous benefits for full-time employees which include but are not limited to:

A guaranteed life-long monthly pension, once vested after 5 years of service
457B Retirement Plan
140 hours of PTO earned within first year + 12 paid holidays, 1 personal holiday, 1 Wellness Day and 1 volunteer day per year
Competitive medical, dental and vision plans effective within 1 month of start date

Location & Schedule

In this position you can expect to work on site at Denver International Airport (parking is provided)

Shifts consist of four (4) 10-hour days.
The primary shift will be discussed in interview and can be any of the shifts listed below. Shifts are yearlong commitments and are subject to change based on operational need.
Day Shift: 0600-1630 (6:00 AM-4:30 PM)
Swing Shift: 1600-0230 (4:00 PM-2:30 AM)
Graveyard Shift: 2000-0600 (8:00PM--6:00 AM)
Shifts are not guaranteed and are subject to change. 7%-12% pay differential depending on shift assigned and equipment operated.
Denver International Airport is a 24/7/365 team operation. If staffing challenges occur, weather conditions warrant or an emergency crisis occur, all DEN employees will be required to work extended hours and/or alternative shifts (includes nights, weekends, and holidays).
Participate in mandatory snow removal duties. Hours for On Call Snow Overtime: 3:30am to 3:30pm or 3:30pm to 3:30am.
Uniforms are provided along with a work boot allowance.
Mobile phone stipend.

Who We Are & What You’ll Do

Since opening on Feb. 28, 1995, Denver International Airport (DEN) has become one of the world’s busiest airports. In 2025, 82,427,962 passengers passed through DEN, making DEN 4th busiest airport in the U.S. and the world’s 10th busiest airport. DEN is Colorado’s primary economic engine, generating $47.2 billion in annual economic impact for the state. At DEN, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We celebrate individuality and strive to keep Equity, Diversity, Inclusion & Accessibility (EDIA) at the center of all that we do.

Denver International Airport’s Field Department is looking for an Airport Field Technician Lead
. In this position, you will execute full performance journey level construction, maintenance, and repair work on a wide variety of linear assets and federally regulated airport surfaces with a focus on asphalt, concrete, and earthwork large, complex, or difficult projects. Employees work in the FAA-regulated Air Operations Area (AOA), requiring enhanced security clearance and airfield driving certification. All maintenance must comply with federal regulations, including CFR Part 139 and FAA Advisory Circular 150/5380-6C.

In this position, you can expect to:

Performs lead work over paving operations in a wide variety of applications to include multi-lane roadways, taxiway shoulders, runway shoulders, and parking lots. Troubleshoots, diagnoses, and resolves problems related to pavement quality and the paving process.
Performs lead work over advanced installation and analyzation of concrete curb and gutter, full panel installations, spall rehabilitations, and foundation work. Quality control and diagnosing problems throughout the mixing process, placement of concrete, and uses advanced finishing techniques.
Manages and tracks assigned work orders for maintenance and maintains documentation, records, and reports through computerized maintenance management system.
Trains employees in the day-to-day procedures of the work unit and mastery of individual knowledge, skills, and abilities essential to work tasks.
Develops or modifies work plans, methods, and procedures; determines work priorities and develops work schedules to provide adequate staff coverage. Provides work instruction and assists employees with difficult and/or unusual assignments. Assigns and distributes work assignments, reviews work for accuracy and completeness and returns assignments with recommendations for proper completion.
Troubleshoots, installs, and monitors ADA compliant pavement surfaces
Sets grade and reads grade stakes for roadway maintenance, earthwork, and construction. Interprets blueprints to excavate, backfill, and shores trenches for electrical and plumbing installations.
Responds to field service calls to troubleshoot, diagnose, and determine necessary actions to complete.
Leads airfield snow removal duties and operates large, complex specialized industrial equipment in accordance with the nature of the work and the efficiency of airport specific multifunctional snow removal equipment.
Responds to grievances and relays information to the supervisor.
Documents situations that may be cause for disciplinary action and provides this information to the supervisor.
Resolves problems encountered during daily operations and determines appropriate solutions.
Monitors and observes common maintenance safety standards.
Prepares and maintains documentation, records, and reports to identify vehicle accident damage and needed repairs.
Responds to airfield emergencies, playing a crucial role in escorting ambulances, fire rescue vehicles, buses, and other first responders during airport emergencies in support of the emergency response plan. Transports emergency response trailers to the scene and assists with the command-site setup.
Responds to after-hours calls or emergency calls outside of normal scheduled or business hours.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Employees may be re-deployed to work in other capacities in their own agencies or in other City agencies to support core functions of the City during a City-wide emergency declared by the mayor.

What You’ll Bring

We value diversity of ethnicity, race, socioeconomic status, sexual identity, gender, religion, language, ability, and experience and exemplify this through the makeup of our team at all levels. You'll be right at home here if you cultivate strong relationships and push yourself, your work, the people around you and Denver to the next level.

Our ideal candidate has some or all the following experience, skills, and characteristics:

Attention of Detail: Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.
Delivering Results: Sets high standards for quality, quantity, and timelines. Focuses on customer needs and satisfaction. Consistently achieves project goals.
Interpersonal Skills: Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, cooperation, concern, and politeness to others and relates well to different people from varied backgrounds and different situations.
Leading and Coaching: Provides others with a clear direction, motivation, and empowers. Recruits staff of a high caliber and provides staff with development opportunities and coaching.
Problem Solving: Identifies and analyzes problems; uses sound reasoning to arrive at conclusions; finds alternative solutions to complex problems; distinguishes between relevant and irrelevant information to make logical judgments.
Reading: Understands and interprets written material including technical material, rules, regulations, instructions, reports, charts, graphs, or tables and applies what is learned from written material to specific situations.
Technical Competence: Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or extensive on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.
Working with People: Shows respect for the views and contributions of other team members. Shows empathy, listens, supports, and cares for others, and reconciles conflict.
Airport Movement Endorsement to operate a vehicle within the airport active “Movement area” that includes runways, taxiways, and safety areas requiring air traffic control clearance and radio communication at time of application or within six months of probation.

Required Minimum Qualifications

Education requirement: Graduation from high school or the possession of a GED, HiSET or TASC Certificate.
Experience Requirement: Three (3) years of experience performing a variety of duties in construction, asphalt, concrete, and earthwork at an airport and three (3) years of airfield snow removal experience and/or experience operating heavy equipment.
Education/Experience Equivalency: A combination of appropriate education and experience may be substituted for the minimum education and experience requirements.
License/Certifications: Requires a valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL "A") with appropriate endorsements at time of application. Requires a valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL "B") at time of application.
Flagger certification is required at the time of application or within six months of probation.
Licenses and certifications must be kept current as a condition of employment.

Internal Candidates Only: Please note that probationary employees are not eligible to apply to open positions until they’ve successfully passed probation. Please only apply if you have already passed probation.

Additional Information

FBI Background Check: FBI criminal background check is required for all positions at Denver International Airport (DEN). Employees are also required to report any felony convictions and/or moving violations to maintain this clearance and be eligible for continued employment. By position, a pre-employment physical/drug test may be required.

Snow / Emergency Duties: Denver International Airport is a 24/7/365 team operation. If weather conditions warrant or an emergency crisis occurs, all DEN employees can be required to work extended hours and/or shifts.

Application Deadline

To be considered for this position, you must include the following on your job application (upload the attachment(s) to the Resume/CV section on the My Experience tab):

Resume

Applications for this position are accepted on a rolling basis. Please submit your application as soon as possible to ensure consideration.

jobs.title: Geospatial Analyst
jobs.description:
Grounded in safety, quality, and ethics, our experts lead their fields with dedication, a creative spirit, and a vision for growth. We draw from more than 20 technical specialties worldwide and are devoted to fostering a community of diverse talents, backgrounds, and expertise. Here, you can apply your passion and collaborate with top environmental professionals on work that’s vital to our clients and the communities they serve.

Join a team that’s naturally committed to the environment.

We are seeking a talented GIS Technician / Geospatial Analyst to join our team. You will be part of a collaborative group of GIS Specialists and Data Services professionals who deliver innovative solutions to both internal and external clients within an ESRI Enterprise environment.

As a member of our Environmental Services Geospatial team—comprising over 160 geospatial professionals, you will help identify client needs and recommend optimal geospatial technologies and solutions to meet business objectives. Our team is solid and experienced, with an average of 15 years of professional expertise. We’re proud to say that our department has a strong retention rate, with employees staying with the company for an average of 10 years

As a Geospatial Analyst with Stantec you will provide technical support which includes mapping applications, spatial analysis, and map production; as well as project support for assigned projects. This is a full-time position working with our Mid-Atlantic Region Environmental Services (ES) group.

Your Key Responsibilities

Compile, create and maintain spatial and non-spatial information for a variety of platforms primarily involving ESRI ArcGIS Software (ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online (AGO)).
Work in Windows 11 Enterprise and using MS Office suite of applications (Teams, Outlook, Word, Access, Excel, SharePoint).
Produce custom thematic map products and carry out data analysis/summaries to support multidisciplinary project deliverables.
Prepare web maps, online dashboards, and manage data for field survey crews, using applications and platforms which include Survey 123, Field Maps, and ArcGIS Online.
Supporting geospatial field data collection efforts. Typical collected features include wetlands, waterways and rare, threatened, or endangered species occurrences or habitats.
Adhering to established cartographic standards and Quality Assurance / Quality Control processes.
Managing a wide variety of project-specific and reference geospatial data in accordance with defined data management standards.
Recognizes when technical problems are developing and initiates appropriate corrective actions.
Collaborating with existing GIS staff members working in other Stantec offices.
Report to the Mid-Atlantic Geospatial Team Lead.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

Educated knowledge and experience working with Esri ArcGIS software suite, primarily ArcPro and ArcGIS Online, as well as ArcGIS Experience Builder, ArcGIS Field Maps, ArcGIS Survey123.
Experience building and using a GIS to solve problems, present results, and graphically report analytical data for multi-disciplinary teams.
Technical training and experience in GIS mapping, geospatial analysis, and geographic principles (e.g., map projections and coordinate systems).
Demonstrates a knowledge of cartography and at least some understanding of graphic design.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Ability to meet project deadlines and understand how assigned tasks relate to project goals.
Ability to maintain and establish effective working relationships.
Ability to perform work accurately in a detail-oriented environment.
Exceptional visual, written, and verbal communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
Understands how to convert data from older sources such as maps and books into accurate digital formats.
Valid state driver’s license

Preferred

Knowledge of Arcade, Python, and other GIS Programming languages.
Working knowledge CAD software, such as AutoCAD or MicroStation platforms.
Experience performing environmental fieldwork using a GPS and post-processing data is beneficial but not required.
Experience working with LiDAR data.

Education and Experience

Bachelors’ degree or equivalent in GIS, Geography, Geoscience, Environmental Science, or related field with demonstrated GIS training or coursework.
Will consider a recent graduate, however 1-3 years of experience providing professional (non-coursework) related GIS Services is preferred.
Prior experience in the delivery of GIS products and analytical solutions as they relate to Environmental Assessments, site assessments, and the Environmental Regulatory Process is an asset.

jobs.title: SURVEY TECHNICIAN
jobs.description:
At Nox Group, we are dedicated to humanizing construction as one of the fastest-growing industrial enterprises in the US. Nox Group owns and operates Corbins, RMCI, Nox Innovations, and Construction Labels, and our teams set the standard as industry leaders. As we continue to expand our reach nationwide, we seek people who are passionate about personal growth and eager to make a positive impact throughout the industries and communities we serve. We prioritize our people, our partners, and our relationships. Start your journey today and join our skilled team.

The Survey Technician is responsible for performing field survey, layout and data collection activities using Trimble RTS and GPS equipment to support construction operations. Working under the direction of the Survey Superintendent, this position ensures that layouts for equipment, conduit, trenching, and structural supports are accurate, documented, and aligned with project design intent. The Survey Technician plays a key role in maintaining project quality, accuracy, and efficiency while upholding all safety and company standards.

Responsibilities

Perform daily field layout activities using Trimble RTS and GPS equipment under the direction of the Survey Superintendent.
Set up, localize, and maintain survey equipment to project control points and verify calibration accuracy.
Execute layout tasks for:
Equipment pads and foundation locations
Trench routing, depth, and slope verification
Underground and overhead conduit pathways
Openings, racks, hangers, and other structural elements requiring layout precision
Field verification of correct installation prior to backfill

Collect and record as-built data for installed components.
Verify layout accuracy through field checks, checklist, and coordination with BIM/CAD models and the project VDC team.
Support the project team in transferring layout data between Trimble equipment and design models.
Assist in organizing survey data files, control points, and field documentation.
Report discrepancies or field challenges to the Survey Superintendent or project management for resolution.
Maintain cleanliness, calibration, and functionality of all Trimble RTS and GPS equipment and accessories.
Follow company and project safety procedures for survey and layout activities within active construction zones.
Participate in daily and weekly project meetings as needed to understand upcoming layout needs.
Provide feedback to improve layout workflows, documentation, and field coordination processes.

Qualifications

3-5 years of experience in survey, layout, or related construction field work preferred.
Working knowledge of Trimble RTS and GPS systems, data collection, and layout procedures; training provided as needed.
Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, civil plans, and basic BIM/CAD layouts.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
Ability to walk or stand on job sites for extended periods of time and lift up to 50 lbs.
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to project sites as required.

Safety Level

This is a safety sensitive position, and all applicable policies including drug test and background check will apply.

The inherent responsibilities of your role may include physical working conditions. In order to safely and successfully perform job duties you must be able to:
Potentially lift up to 50 pounds
Potentially need to do repeated pushing, pulling, carrying, reaching (or working above shoulder), walking, standing, sitting, stooping, kneeling, bending, and climbing
Potentially operate a motor vehicle, crane, tractor, etc.

We reserve the right to continually monitor your ability to safely and successfully complete these inherent physical responsibilities and take action as deemed appropriate in accordance with the Americans with Disability Act (ADA)

At INDUS, we believe in the value of the INDUS team. Together we deliver exceptional customer service, foster a growth and support-centered work environment, and focus on how we can give back to the communities that we serve. Empowering our employees starts on day one and creates an environment full of innovation and promise. By offering mentorship and robust Training and Development opportunities, INDUS continues its pursuit to be the Employer of Choice.

The Naval Undersea Warfare Center Division, Newport (NUWCDIVNPT) is a naval research activity operating under the direction of the Commander, Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA). The Corporate Operations Department (Code 10), Code 00, TD and Naval Undersea Warfare Center (NUWC) Headquarters (HQ) are an integral part of NUWCDIVNPT, responsible for providing timely and cost efficient business and operational services to the overall Division. These services include Human Resources, Infrastructure, Corporate Communications, Activity Chief Information Officer (ACIO)/Information Technology, Security, and Corporate Business Office functions. The Corporate Operations Department provides these responsive and affordable services to effectively support a workforce of approximately 3,000 government employees. The Corporate Operations Department provides administrative and technical services to all of NUWCDIVNPT including NUWC HQ in the areas of data gathering and analysis; technical writing; preparation of graphic material; data entry; database maintenance and administration; and software verification maintenance. The department also provides administrative research, analysis, and support services that include researching solutions; maintaining, reviewing and assessing compliance with governing guidance; and documenting, preparing, organizing and distributing all forms of communication.

Reporting to the Program Manager, the Power Platform Developer/Data Analyst
is responsible for providing database architecture, design, and modeling through various DoN and NAVSEA systems in support of the Code 10 Administrative Support Services
contract
. This position is located in Newport, RI.

Develop data models and structures that support accurate, efficient reporting and analytics.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI and related data tools.
Design and document data flows and architecture from source systems to final reporting outputs.
Use Power Platform tools (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) to support data entry, workflow automation, and process improvement.
Implement appropriate data security, access controls, and compliance measures.
Collaborate with leadership and staff to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
Participate in meetings and coordinate with personnel across various roles and backgrounds.
Adhere to all records management, security, and regulatory policies established by the command.
Bid and proposal support if requested.
Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

An active secret clearance is required to be considered for this position.
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university required, with strong experience supporting program operations, analytics, or performance tracking.
One to three or more years of experience in program management, data analysis, or related operational support roles.
Experience working in Department of Defense (DoD) or government environments.
Expert-level experience with SharePoint Online and Microsoft Lists, including building and maintaining collaborative tracking tools and dashboards.
Expert-level experience with Power Automate, designing automated workflows to streamline reporting and program communications.
Intermediate experience with Power Apps, supporting data entry and process improvement applications.
Proficient in Power BI, with experience developing and maintaining dashboards that visualize key metrics, resource utilization, and program performance.
Intermediate understanding of data modeling and organizing data for effective visualization and reporting.
Experience utilizing DoD systems such as Flank Speed.
Must possess basic computer literacy and data entry skills.
Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (to include MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Work is diverse and may not always fall under established practices and guidelines.

Valid driver’s license required.

Associate’s degree in natural resources; environmental studies or equivalent combination of education and 6 months’ experience.

Field experience.

new_jobs.description:
About Our Job

With competitive pay, great benefits, and endless opportunities, working for the City and County of Denver means seeing yourself working with purpose — for you, and those who benefit from your passion, skills and expertise. Join our diverse, inclusive and talented workforce of more than 11,000 team members who are at the heart of what makes Denver, Denver.

What We Offer

The City and County of Denver offers competitive pay commensurate with education and experience. The salary range for this position is $26.56-$45.82. New hires are typically brought into the organization between $36.75-41.50/hour based on experience. We also offer generous benefits for full-time employees which include but are not limited to:

A guaranteed life-long monthly pension, once vested after 5 years of service
457B Retirement Plan
140 hours of PTO earned within first year + 12 paid holidays, 1 personal holiday, 1 Wellness Day and 1 volunteer day per year
Competitive medical, dental and vision plans effective within 1 month of start date

Location & Schedule

In this position you can expect to work on site at Denver International Airport (parking is provided)

Shifts consist of four (4) 10-hour days.
The primary shift will be discussed in interview and can be any of the shifts listed below. Shifts are yearlong commitments and are subject to change based on operational need.
Day Shift: 0600-1630 (6:00 AM-4:30 PM)
Swing Shift: 1600-0230 (4:00 PM-2:30 AM)
Graveyard Shift: 2000-0600 (8:00PM--6:00 AM)
Shifts are not guaranteed and are subject to change. 7%-12% pay differential depending on shift assigned and equipment operated.
Denver International Airport is a 24/7/365 team operation. If staffing challenges occur, weather conditions warrant or an emergency crisis occur, all DEN employees will be required to work extended hours and/or alternative shifts (includes nights, weekends, and holidays).
Participate in mandatory snow removal duties. Hours for On Call Snow Overtime: 3:30am to 3:30pm or 3:30pm to 3:30am.
Uniforms are provided along with a work boot allowance.
Mobile phone stipend.

Who We Are & What You’ll Do

Since opening on Feb. 28, 1995, Denver International Airport (DEN) has become one of the world’s busiest airports. In 2025, 82,427,962 passengers passed through DEN, making DEN 4th busiest airport in the U.S. and the world’s 10th busiest airport. DEN is Colorado’s primary economic engine, generating $47.2 billion in annual economic impact for the state. At DEN, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We celebrate individuality and strive to keep Equity, Diversity, Inclusion & Accessibility (EDIA) at the center of all that we do.

Denver International Airport’s Field Department is looking for an Airport Field Technician Lead
. In this position, you will execute full performance journey level construction, maintenance, and repair work on a wide variety of linear assets and federally regulated airport surfaces with a focus on asphalt, concrete, and earthwork large, complex, or difficult projects. Employees work in the FAA-regulated Air Operations Area (AOA), requiring enhanced security clearance and airfield driving certification. All maintenance must comply with federal regulations, including CFR Part 139 and FAA Advisory Circular 150/5380-6C.

In this position, you can expect to:

Performs lead work over paving operations in a wide variety of applications to include multi-lane roadways, taxiway shoulders, runway shoulders, and parking lots. Troubleshoots, diagnoses, and resolves problems related to pavement quality and the paving process.
Performs lead work over advanced installation and analyzation of concrete curb and gutter, full panel installations, spall rehabilitations, and foundation work. Quality control and diagnosing problems throughout the mixing process, placement of concrete, and uses advanced finishing techniques.
Manages and tracks assigned work orders for maintenance and maintains documentation, records, and reports through computerized maintenance management system.
Trains employees in the day-to-day procedures of the work unit and mastery of individual knowledge, skills, and abilities essential to work tasks.
Develops or modifies work plans, methods, and procedures; determines work priorities and develops work schedules to provide adequate staff coverage. Provides work instruction and assists employees with difficult and/or unusual assignments. Assigns and distributes work assignments, reviews work for accuracy and completeness and returns assignments with recommendations for proper completion.
Troubleshoots, installs, and monitors ADA compliant pavement surfaces
Sets grade and reads grade stakes for roadway maintenance, earthwork, and construction. Interprets blueprints to excavate, backfill, and shores trenches for electrical and plumbing installations.
Responds to field service calls to troubleshoot, diagnose, and determine necessary actions to complete.
Leads airfield snow removal duties and operates large, complex specialized industrial equipment in accordance with the nature of the work and the efficiency of airport specific multifunctional snow removal equipment.
Responds to grievances and relays information to the supervisor.
Documents situations that may be cause for disciplinary action and provides this information to the supervisor.
Resolves problems encountered during daily operations and determines appropriate solutions.
Monitors and observes common maintenance safety standards.
Prepares and maintains documentation, records, and reports to identify vehicle accident damage and needed repairs.
Responds to airfield emergencies, playing a crucial role in escorting ambulances, fire rescue vehicles, buses, and other first responders during airport emergencies in support of the emergency response plan. Transports emergency response trailers to the scene and assists with the command-site setup.
Responds to after-hours calls or emergency calls outside of normal scheduled or business hours.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Employees may be re-deployed to work in other capacities in their own agencies or in other City agencies to support core functions of the City during a City-wide emergency declared by the mayor.

What You’ll Bring

We value diversity of ethnicity, race, socioeconomic status, sexual identity, gender, religion, language, ability, and experience and exemplify this through the makeup of our team at all levels. You'll be right at home here if you cultivate strong relationships and push yourself, your work, the people around you and Denver to the next level.

Our ideal candidate has some or all the following experience, skills, and characteristics:

Attention of Detail: Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.
Delivering Results: Sets high standards for quality, quantity, and timelines. Focuses on customer needs and satisfaction. Consistently achieves project goals.
Interpersonal Skills: Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, cooperation, concern, and politeness to others and relates well to different people from varied backgrounds and different situations.
Leading and Coaching: Provides others with a clear direction, motivation, and empowers. Recruits staff of a high caliber and provides staff with development opportunities and coaching.
Problem Solving: Identifies and analyzes problems; uses sound reasoning to arrive at conclusions; finds alternative solutions to complex problems; distinguishes between relevant and irrelevant information to make logical judgments.
Reading: Understands and interprets written material including technical material, rules, regulations, instructions, reports, charts, graphs, or tables and applies what is learned from written material to specific situations.
Technical Competence: Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or extensive on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.
Working with People: Shows respect for the views and contributions of other team members. Shows empathy, listens, supports, and cares for others, and reconciles conflict.
Airport Movement Endorsement to operate a vehicle within the airport active “Movement area” that includes runways, taxiways, and safety areas requiring air traffic control clearance and radio communication at time of application or within six months of probation.

Required Minimum Qualifications

Education requirement: Graduation from high school or the possession of a GED, HiSET or TASC Certificate.
Experience Requirement: Three (3) years of experience performing a variety of duties in construction, asphalt, concrete, and earthwork at an airport and three (3) years of airfield snow removal experience and/or experience operating heavy equipment.
Education/Experience Equivalency: A combination of appropriate education and experience may be substituted for the minimum education and experience requirements.
License/Certifications: Requires a valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL "A") with appropriate endorsements at time of application. Requires a valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL "B") at time of application.
Flagger certification is required at the time of application or within six months of probation.
Licenses and certifications must be kept current as a condition of employment.

Internal Candidates Only: Please note that probationary employees are not eligible to apply to open positions until they’ve successfully passed probation. Please only apply if you have already passed probation.

Additional Information

FBI Background Check: FBI criminal background check is required for all positions at Denver International Airport (DEN). Employees are also required to report any felony convictions and/or moving violations to maintain this clearance and be eligible for continued employment. By position, a pre-employment physical/drug test may be required.

Snow / Emergency Duties: Denver International Airport is a 24/7/365 team operation. If weather conditions warrant or an emergency crisis occurs, all DEN employees can be required to work extended hours and/or shifts.

Resume

Applications for this position are accepted on a rolling basis. Please submit your application as soon as possible to ensure consideration.

As a member of our Environmental Services Geospatial team—comprising over 160 geospatial professionals, you will help identify client needs and recommend optimal geospatial technologies and solutions to meet business objectives. Our team is solid and experienced, with an average of 15 years of professional expertise. We’re proud to say that our department has a strong retention rate, with employees staying with the company for an average of 10 years

As a Geospatial Analyst with Stantec you will provide technical support which includes mapping applications, spatial analysis, and map production; as well as project support for assigned projects. This is a full-time position working with our Mid-Atlantic Region Environmental Services (ES) group.

Your Key Responsibilities

Compile, create and maintain spatial and non-spatial information for a variety of platforms primarily involving ESRI ArcGIS Software (ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online (AGO)).
Work in Windows 11 Enterprise and using MS Office suite of applications (Teams, Outlook, Word, Access, Excel, SharePoint).
Produce custom thematic map products and carry out data analysis/summaries to support multidisciplinary project deliverables.
Prepare web maps, online dashboards, and manage data for field survey crews, using applications and platforms which include Survey 123, Field Maps, and ArcGIS Online.
Supporting geospatial field data collection efforts. Typical collected features include wetlands, waterways and rare, threatened, or endangered species occurrences or habitats.
Adhering to established cartographic standards and Quality Assurance / Quality Control processes.
Managing a wide variety of project-specific and reference geospatial data in accordance with defined data management standards.
Recognizes when technical problems are developing and initiates appropriate corrective actions.
Collaborating with existing GIS staff members working in other Stantec offices.
Report to the Mid-Atlantic Geospatial Team Lead.

Educated knowledge and experience working with Esri ArcGIS software suite, primarily ArcPro and ArcGIS Online, as well as ArcGIS Experience Builder, ArcGIS Field Maps, ArcGIS Survey123.
Experience building and using a GIS to solve problems, present results, and graphically report analytical data for multi-disciplinary teams.
Technical training and experience in GIS mapping, geospatial analysis, and geographic principles (e.g., map projections and coordinate systems).
Demonstrates a knowledge of cartography and at least some understanding of graphic design.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Ability to meet project deadlines and understand how assigned tasks relate to project goals.
Ability to maintain and establish effective working relationships.
Ability to perform work accurately in a detail-oriented environment.
Exceptional visual, written, and verbal communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
Understands how to convert data from older sources such as maps and books into accurate digital formats.
Valid state driver’s license

Knowledge of Arcade, Python, and other GIS Programming languages.
Working knowledge CAD software, such as AutoCAD or MicroStation platforms.
Experience performing environmental fieldwork using a GPS and post-processing data is beneficial but not required.
Experience working with LiDAR data.

Education and Experience

Bachelors’ degree or equivalent in GIS, Geography, Geoscience, Environmental Science, or related field with demonstrated GIS training or coursework.
Will consider a recent graduate, however 1-3 years of experience providing professional (non-coursework) related GIS Services is preferred.
Prior experience in the delivery of GIS products and analytical solutions as they relate to Environmental Assessments, site assessments, and the Environmental Regulatory Process is an asset.

new_jobs.description:
At Nox Group, we are dedicated to humanizing construction as one of the fastest-growing industrial enterprises in the US. Nox Group owns and operates Corbins, RMCI, Nox Innovations, and Construction Labels, and our teams set the standard as industry leaders. As we continue to expand our reach nationwide, we seek people who are passionate about personal growth and eager to make a positive impact throughout the industries and communities we serve. We prioritize our people, our partners, and our relationships. Start your journey today and join our skilled team.

The Survey Technician is responsible for performing field survey, layout and data collection activities using Trimble RTS and GPS equipment to support construction operations. Working under the direction of the Survey Superintendent, this position ensures that layouts for equipment, conduit, trenching, and structural supports are accurate, documented, and aligned with project design intent. The Survey Technician plays a key role in maintaining project quality, accuracy, and efficiency while upholding all safety and company standards.

Responsibilities

Perform daily field layout activities using Trimble RTS and GPS equipment under the direction of the Survey Superintendent.
Set up, localize, and maintain survey equipment to project control points and verify calibration accuracy.
Execute layout tasks for:
Equipment pads and foundation locations
Trench routing, depth, and slope verification
Underground and overhead conduit pathways
Openings, racks, hangers, and other structural elements requiring layout precision
Field verification of correct installation prior to backfill

Collect and record as-built data for installed components.
Verify layout accuracy through field checks, checklist, and coordination with BIM/CAD models and the project VDC team.

The Kellogg School of Management at Northwestern University is proud of its global network of more than 72,000 alumni.  With a network as broad as ours, we know how important it is to facilitate connections between and among our alumni in order to build a strong, engaged global community.  As an elite global business school, the Kellogg Alumni Relations and Advancement team supports a breadth of opportunities for our alumni to connect with each other as well as the school, including social and professional networking, continued learning, career advice and more.

As a staff member on the Alumni Relations Analytics team, the Program Coordinator is responsible for providing critical operational support to the Alumni Relations and Operations teams. Responsibilities include supporting aspects of events, managing data reporting needs and entry into the data system, writing and proofreading support, processing checks received and creating the daily gift log, help with scheduling team meetings and logistics, and supporting the creation of new accounts for new gifts.

Events

Assists with contract negotiations as needed.

Assists with developing plans for events, including the Cvent registration creation, invitation creation, and event follow-up plans.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Ability to manage team meetings, including invites, agendas, room reservation, and use of technology

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
